item.text: Place a washable mat just inside the door and assign each roommate a narrow “parking lane” along one wall, with toe ends facing the wall to minimize depth. Keep only the pair currently in use there; move off-season or occasional shoes to each person’s bedroom. Use existing baskets, tote bags, or shoeboxes under a bench or beside the mat for slippers and loose items. Agree that the doorway and door-swing area stay completely clear, with a quick nightly reset.
